proposal.summary: New AIPOS state entries are written one per file under .aipos/state.d (PR #2709) so parallel PRs stop editing the same state.yaml lines. Step 2 of the AI handoff contract must therefore tell every AI to read .aipos/state.d/*.yaml as well as .aipos/state.yaml.

impact_analysis.analysis: One line in step 2 of the handoff reading list changes from reading state.yaml to reading state.yaml and every state.d/*.yaml. No validator, authority, safety, risk, execution, credential or LIVE path changes. Every existing state.yaml entry stays where it is; validators read fixed control keys by name and none of them list all entries (checked by the non-author review). Reverting the line restores the previous reading list.

migration_plan.compatibility: Additive. state.yaml keeps every existing entry; state.d adds new entries only; scripts/aipos-state-insert.js --inline keeps the old behaviour.
steps: Merge PR #2709 (script, tests, contract line, AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md lines).
New entries are added with scripts/aipos-state-insert.js, which writes .aipos/state.d/<key>.yaml.

triggers: Any AI or validator misses a state entry because it read state.yaml only, or a consumer breaks on state.d.
procedure: Move any .aipos/state.d/*.yaml entries back into .aipos/state.yaml with scripts/aipos-state-insert.js --inline.
